text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian finishes first at the Arima Kinen. However, she and Biwa Hayahide are both aiming to achieve even greater goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the stands, Symboli Rudolf's heart leaps with quiet excitement. She too wants to face Narita Brian someday…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those who have been defeated are aiming for the top, just the same as Narita Brian. They will always continue to be her competitors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtain falls on the Arima Kinen. Narita Brian will continue to run from here on out in her never-ending search for stronger opponents.
